"""Drain a queue into a list."""
import queue
import threading

def drain(q: queue.Queue) -> list[int]:
    items = []
    event = threading.Event()
    
    def worker():
        while True:
            try:
                item = q.get_nowait()
                items.append(item)
            except queue.Empty:
                event.set()
                return
    
    thread = threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    event.wait()
    return items

def demo():
    q = queue.Queue()
    q.put(1)
    q.put(2)
    return drain(q)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(demo())
